string.name: name
string.value: Teleport Rock

string.name: desc
string.value: A rock that can memorize 5 maps, and then allow you to #cteleport to the memorized maps# at any time. It can be used to #cmove to the map where a particular character is# as long as they're in your world and channel. This item cannot be used for moving to #cMirror World#.

Excluding maps that are restricted from teleporting into, up to #c10# maps can be registered. This item cannot be used for moving to #cMirror World#.

string.value: Premium VIP Teleport Rock

string.name: desc
string.value:
#cA rock which allows you to teleport between continents#. It can be used to #cmove to the map where a particular character is# as long as they're in your channel.
